description: The one place pipeline order is declared. The three stage modules never import this or each other (ADR-009); only orchestration knows the sequence.
signature:
class PipelineStage(StrEnum):
    ACQUISITION = 'acquisition'
    ENRICHMENT = 'enrichment'
    ANALYSIS = 'analysis'

RUN_LEVEL_STAGE: Final[str] = 'pipeline'
docstring:
PipelineStage: Declaration order is execution order -- list(PipelineStage) IS the pipeline. Values are byte-identical to run_events.stage / run_stages.stage strings and to the run_stages CHECK constraint literals ('acquisition', 'enrichment', 'analysis'), so a stage's enum value can be written directly into either table with no translation layer.

RUN_LEVEL_STAGE: The run_events.stage value used for run-level records that are not tied to one stage (preflight, run started, run finished, cancellation requested). Deliberately a plain string constant, not a PipelineStage member, because it is not executable and must never be accepted by begin_run_stage/finish_run_stage (which are constrained to the three real stages by the run_stages CHECK).
postconditions: list(PipelineStage) == [PipelineStage.ACQUISITION, PipelineStage.ENRICHMENT, PipelineStage.ANALYSIS], in that exact order
Every PipelineStage.value is accepted by the run_stages.stage CHECK constraint
RUN_LEVEL_STAGE is never equal to any PipelineStage.value

edge_cases.input: storage.begin_run_stage called with RUN_LEVEL_STAGE as the stage argument
edge_cases.expected_behavior: StorageError from the CHECK constraint -- this is a caller bug orchestration must never trigger; RUN_LEVEL_STAGE is only ever passed to append_run_event, never to begin_run_stage/finish_run_stage

edge_cases.input: A future fourth pipeline stage is added
edge_cases.expected_behavior: requires a new PipelineStage member AND a matching run_stages.stage CHECK constraint update (a storage migration) -- the two must change together, never one without the other

unit_tests.name: test_declaration_order_is_execution_order
unit_tests.description: list(PipelineStage) matches the documented three-stage sequence exactly.

unit_tests.name: test_values_match_run_stages_check_literals
unit_tests.description: Every PipelineStage value is one of the run_stages CHECK-constrained literals, asserted against the schema string in 01_storage.module_spec.json.
unit_tests.expected: all three values present in the CHECK set

unit_tests.name: test_run_level_stage_distinct_from_pipeline_stages
unit_tests.description: RUN_LEVEL_STAGE is not equal to any PipelineStage member's value.
